none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

budget.value: fun p => ⌈p.L / p.μ * Real.log (1 + 2 * p.Δ / p.ε)⌉₊ * (p.d + 2)

budgets.value: fun p => ⌈p.L / p.μ * Real.log (1 + 2 * p.Δ / p.ε)⌉₊ * (p.d + 2)

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Nonconvex objectives are permitted: global PL and L-Lipschitz gradient are required, but convexity is not.

problem_class.label: pl
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable objective with an attained global minimum and global PL inequality 2μ(f(x)−f(xstar)) ≤ ‖∇f(x)‖². The initial objective gap is at most Δ.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: Each sequential call k queries x and returns the scalar f(x)+a(q)+b(q)r+e(k,x), where q=⌊k/(d+2)⌋ and r=k mod (d+2). The reply is independent of the oracle seed. All scalar calls count toward the fixed budget.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/AffineDriftPL.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: biased_oracle
distinctive_assumptions.details: Residual function-value errors satisfy |e(k,x)| ≤ ν uniformly over calls and points, without unbiasedness, independence, or stochastic moment assumptions. Valid parameters obey 4dLν ≤ με.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/AffineDriftPL.lean: spec.admissible residual bound and spec.valid.

distinctive_assumptions.label: affine_drift
distinctive_assumptions.details: Unknown arbitrary intercept a(q) and slope b(q) within each aligned block of d+2 sequential calls. Neither coefficient is bounded, and both can change arbitrarily between blocks.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/AffineDriftPL.lean: spec.admissible, existential a, b, e.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The domain, queries, and output lie in d-dimensional real Euclidean space, with d>0.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ZerothOrderSmoothAndConvex.lean: ZerothOrder.Point; LongTails/Setups/AffineDriftPL.lean: spec.Instance, spec.Query, spec.Output, spec.valid.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient is globally L-Lipschitz, with 0<μ≤L and ε>0. Public algorithm inputs are d, L, μ, ε, and x0; Δ≥0 and ν≥0 are hidden parameters. Drift coefficients and residual errors are not supplied to the algorithm.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/AffineDriftPL.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.makeAlgorithm.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a single point whose latent objective gap satisfies f(output)−f(xstar) ≤ ε for a global minimizer xstar.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee holds almost surely under the execution probability law. Oracle cost is bounded for every seed by the fixed budget ⌈(L/μ)log(1+2Δ/ε)⌉(d+2).
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/AffineDriftPL.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence; supplied extracted budget for OracleTemplate.AffineDriftPL.result.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Smooth PL minimization uses a sequential function-value oracle with arbitrary blockwise affine temporal drift and uniformly bounded residual errors constrained by the target accuracy. This structured observation model is an unusual variant of standard zeroth-order optimization.
